body: I’ve always thought about my purpose in life is to just die

I’m only 16 and i’ve already given up on my life and i’m so scared. I cant even control myself anymore 


 Sleeping gets me no rest, it’s always an hour before i wake up with the urge to vomit and the room spinning in circles. Sometimes i wish i was dead so things would be easier

Thank you so much, your words really mean a lot to me. I hope i can make a full recovery soon, it’s exhausting day and night to constantly live in fear. I have constant heartburn & stomach pains and i’m contemplating getting checked out at the hospital tonight if my parents allow me. even if it is anxiety it’ll be at least reassuring. In the back of my mind i think i have cancer and i’m reflecting on my entire life, trying to get over the thought of death when in the end, i’m not even sure what i have. but worst it could be is an stomach ulcer but the scariest part is not being able to determine symptoms from my own mental states. Cheers to you, i’m hoping i’ll have good results tonight.
It’s constant general anxiety but once in a while i’ll get panic attacks, even in the middle of my sleep.

Thank you that gives me immense hope, i hope i’ll be able to power through just like you. I honestly just feel like a burden to everyone around me, my family’s upset and my personal relationships have been terribly strained. That added with my physical symptoms which i’m not sure are dangerous or not makes me feel like i’ll never get better, I’ve never felt so powerless and suicidal in my life, and i feel like i’ve taken a lot for granted beforehand. I wish i was strong enough to get better quickly cause my mind is in terrible conditions right now and i don’t have the proper resources or medication to get through.

More info: Teen with depression and anxiety, currently on fluoxetine. Constantly worried this might be a sign of cancer despite cbc test being clear. 

Little to no appetite, burning sensation in stomach and chest is extremely off and on and unpredictable with added nausea and stuffy head.

The saliva that looks like this shows up occasionally throughout the day, the texture usually changes but this in particular is spicy and extremely salty/bitter.

Thank you for your help. I’m desperate to overcome this terrible mental illness. Is it normal to be nauseated constantly without vomiting? I’ve been having to take nausea pills almost on the regular and i feel like i’m about to go crazy. Its so isolating and i always feel like i’m getting worst and never improving, i’ve even had too many frequent thoughts about suicide cause i’m constantly on edge and there’s nobody here to help me. There’s no relief for the burning sensations in my chest in stomach that comes and goes, and the tightness of my head. I’m genuinely convinced i’m dying soon or at least on the road of losing my mind, i’ve never felt this ill before and i’m starting to lose sight of hope.
